newsitem.title: UK: BFI slips to 1,515 on weaker Panamax rates.
newsitem.headline: BFI slips to 1,515 on weaker Panamax rates.

text.p: The Baltic Freight Index (BFI) eased by six points on Friday to 1,515, brokers said.

Brokers reported easier conditions for Panamaxs in the U.S. Gulf. Continental fixed the Great Dove for 50,000/10,000 tonnes soyabean (56 feet) U.S. Gulf to Shanghai at a weak lumpsum equivalent of $25.
In the Pacific Dreyfus fixed the Vitali for 52,500 tonnes heavy grain NOPAC/South Korea for early December at a firm $16.25 (some reports of $16.50).
